domain-information: A Postal Clerk receives packages from customers and issues receipts to confirm acceptance
A Postal Clerk weighs mail and calculates postage to ensure correct pricing
A Sorting Officer organizes incoming mail by destination and scans items to track their location
A Sorting Officer prepares delivery batches to streamline routes for carriers
A Delivery Carrier picks up sorted packages and delivers them to recipients on schedule
A Delivery Carrier updates delivery status to inform the post office and customers
A Sender fills out a shipping form and chooses a delivery option to send a parcel efficiently
A Recipient tracks their incoming package online and confirms receipt to complete the delivery

associations.description: Customer prepares or submits the Package
Postal Clerk accepts and processes the Package
Postage reflects the cost of sending the Package
Customer pays or reviews the Postage
Sorting Officer organizes and scans the Mail
Sorting Officer prepares the Delivery Batch
Receipt Confirmation indicates the Mail was received
Customer reviews tracking details along the Route
Customer fills out the Shipping Form
Shipping Form provides details about the Package
